description: One fixture set for both parsers of a pull request's Release impact block (SPC-013 R-96, TSK-106 AC-8): scripts/release.py (parse_release_impact) and the Rust PR-body check (codeflow ci, pr_body::release at the default policy). Each case is a whole PR body and whether its block is valid. The cases cover the block's shared structure and field rules; CodeFlow's own rules (Unit and Evidence, the legacy Contract field, and Breaking if and only if major) are tested by scripts/test_release.py alone, so every body carries Unit and Evidence.
